# h3_dns_zone (Data Source)

Look up an existing zone of a project by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "h3_dns_zone" "existing" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID; the provider default when omitted

### Read-Only

- `dnssec` (Boolean)
- `ds_records` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String)
- `status` (String)
